coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of five ground-truth variable items are represented: fixed JaxMARL/SMAX hardware resources, the MAPPO–QMIX comparison, and wall-clock time to defined performance thresholds as an approximation to convergence time.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design uses six scenarios rather than nine and includes a map with more than 10 units. It adds IPPO and VDN beyond the specified algorithms. Normalized return uses random/expert baseline scaling rather than score divided by the scenario maximum. Its primary training-time metric measures a fixed step budget; threshold timing only approximately matches time to convergence.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It omits both the expected 6× PPO training speedup and PPO's expected normalized-score advantage in most SMAX scenarios due to training stability and effective policy optimization.
